lw_pla.name: colorFabb LW-PLA (foaming)
lw_pla.note: Foams in the nozzle above about 230 C. Data sheet: Young's modulus 3350 MPa unfoamed (200 C, 100 % flow) and 860 MPa foamed (250 C, 45 % flow); unfoamed density 1.2 g/cm3. The printed density 0.54 g/cm3 is derived for 45 % flow. Price $30.55 for 750 g, excluding VAT.

pla_aero.name: Bambu Lab PLA Aero (foaming)
pla_aero.note: Bambu: filament density 1.21 g/cm3, prints 50 % to 80 % as dense; the record holds the middle, 65 %. Bending modulus 1690 MPa along the layers (ISO 178) on specimens printed at 210 C, which foams little; the stiffness of a fully foamed print is not published.

varioshore_tpu.name: colorFabb varioShore TPU (foaming, soft)
varioshore_tpu.note: Shore 92A TPU that foams above about 230 C and grows 1.4 to 1.6 times; density 1.22 g/cm3 unfoamed (ASTM D-792). The printed density is derived for 1.5 times. A soft core between two PLA skins damps a wall (constrained-layer damping). No price sourced yet.

data_source.title: colorFabb varioShore TPU technical datasheet v1.0 (2019)

youngs_source.title: Bambu TPU 95A Technical Data Sheet V3.0
youngs_source.note: colorFabb publishes no modulus for varioShore (its sheet v1.0 of 2023-03-14 gives Shore 92A, 1.22 g/cm3, 58.6 MPa tensile strength). Derived: the nearest published printed TPU, Bambu TPU 95A, 9.2 MPa along the layers (ISO 527), scaled to the foamed density 813 of 1220 kg/m3 by the square of the density ratio: 4.09 MPa. Uncertain by a factor of two or more.

loss_factor_source.title: Tom Irvine, Damping Properties of Materials, Revision D (Vibrationdata, 2010-07-02), Table 3
loss_factor_source.note: A generic figure for rubber: Table 3 gives rubber a damping ratio of about 0.05, and the document's own relation, loss factor = 2 x damping ratio, gives 0.10. Not measured for this filament.
